Era XIV · The Road of No Return
Alas, the End was never a home.
No soil, no water, no real food.
The Builders could live only on the dragon's breath the Ender Dragons dropped,
and on whatever they could carry back by teleporting home for supplies.
In time, they began to change.
able to blink through the void, and quick to anger at any who looked at them.
an instinct, perhaps. A longing for home.
The Ender Folk you see at night are not monsters.
They are Builders who went to the End and never came back.
the villagers went on multiplying, the Warlocks went on raiding the villages,
and the Undead Rot went on breeding zombies and skeletons in the night.
The Echo Sentinel still slumbered deep underground, guarding the Ancient City.
the world had already lain in ruin for thousands of years.
